reviews.text: Excellent service

The pricing was a shock. This side of town needs a vet clinic with more low price options like The $99 vaccine bundle we would be more likely to bring our pets in more often and prevent the major problems down the line. And as for pet insurance, keep in mind that most of us are struggling to get by and are lucky to afford insurance for ourselves

From the receptionist to the assistant to the vet, they were all awesome. They were very caring and sensitive to my babies needs. They did an extreme great job at explaining in detail what was wrong with him. Thank you very much Vetco for taking care of my little doggy.
The doctor and assistant were very informative and helpful.

Dr. Perez and Leyla were amazing! They were very attentive and helpful during our visit and gave me informative resources for care after the exam. My cat was in the best hands. Thank you so much!

If you have a big dog DO NOT COME HERE. I own a doberman my wife took him so we could figure out what was wrong with him. One of the technicians was trying to touch him which when she did he bared his teeth (more of a face scrounge). Understandably she was worried at first but after being told by my wife that he smiles and that it is not aggression they tried to act as if she didn’t know what she was talking about. After bringing in the vet and explaining as well to the vet it is not aggression the vet then proceeded to tell her that if he were to bite that they would put MY dog down. To make it worse they then put a muzzle on him scaring my dog and labeled him as an aggressive dog on his files. Rodeo is a very kind and gentle dog that just like smile when he is excited. If you are gonna claim to be a vet then at the very least learn how to take care of big dogs and tendencys of doberman.

Brought our dog in due to random vomiting. The staff was excellent. However the vet came in, covered every possible cause along with each method to test and treat. Then said she needed to leave and take the technician with her. The technician returned a short time later with a list of every conceivable test and the price tag for each and asked what I wanted to do. After asking a few questions I took a stab in the dark and went with a possible food allergy and opted to try the expensive food. Probably not returning for the follow up.
Super great experience I came in so worried about my kitty and they gave me a game plan ensured I could afford it and I knew how we were gonna move forward
We're sorry to hear that your recent experience resulted in a less-than-positive rating. Your feedback is important to us.
Laurie was amazing! She’s seen my fur baby twice now and she makes her feel so comfortable. She’s extremely helpful and listened to all my concerns. I will definitely request her on my next visit 🙂 …

My appointment was at 2 PM, but I arrived 30 minutes early since I live pretty far away. They were able to take me in right away, and the staff was very polite, professional, and welcoming. My baby is deaf and usually very nervous around other people, but they were so patient and loving with her, which made her feel safe and comfortable.

They also took the time to thoroughly check her skin issues and examine her ears to figure out what could be causing the problem. I really appreciated how attentive and caring they were throughout the whole visit, making sure all my concerns were addressed. You can truly tell they care about the animals they treat. I’ll definitely be coming back with my other fur babies for their annual checkups.

First time I visited vetco and I have to say it went smoothly and very fast, it was very professional and overall got the all the care I needed for my dog, I want to give Bethany a huge thank you for making my first experience wonderful, for that I will be sure to visit here again when needed.
Team was so friendly. I asked Leyla 100 questions and she answered every question and was super helpful
Great experience with techs & dr. Richard..
Excellent service! Everyone was so nice! I will definitely come back
Bethany was excellent
Leyla was super informative. She was great with my fur baby. Very content with her service.

We had an awesome experience here. We had technician Leyla and she did a great job with our furry son Blanco. She did a great job caring for him while being very professional. You can tell she knows what she is doing and genuinely cares for her patients (animals). Thank you for everything.
everyone was super sweet and helpful especially Leyla and Dr.dishinger. Made me feel very much welcomed during my visit !
Very professional and gentle with my very nervous cat.  Thank you very much.

Tech dez helped My wife , with her new puppy I got her for mother day . She had a bad experience with the First Lady at vetco she went to at a different location , tech dez made her feel welcome and was happy she was able to get the all of his shots and future visit paid for. Se military staff at vetco was very kind . Tech dez went above and beyond to help my wife get seen that day . Thank you. Happy wife , happy life.

Tech dez helped my sister with her new puppy and she talks about how she had the best experience with tech dez. We live far but she says it’s worth it because of how she made her feel comfortable and special during the time of her visit. Thank you tech dez for helping my new family member get the shot he needs and his future appointments set up.

Tech dez and staff was amazing help ,Went with my daughter today, for her pups medication , she was in and out thanks to tech Dez for the easy and great experience. Will definitely be coming back with future visit. Tech Dez is very kind and help. Always a pleasure getting helped out by her.

This was my 2nd vetco I went to & I absolutely loved tech dez , she was very knowledgeable and helpful and kind! I had a terrible experience at the first vetco at Ingram area . Tech dez turn my whole experience around and made me feel welcome! It’s a far drive where I live , but it’s worth going to this vetco ! Tech dez made me and my dog feel very special and comfortable. Explained everything very well, and helped me get the best plan for me and my new puppy Theo.
Regular check up for our Boston Terrier

Super amazing! Dez was so great! She gave me so much reassurance that my Kylo Bear would be safe and sound with them in the back. And I was pretty nervous. She was super friendly very helpful and very attentive. They were fast and they really got my Kylo to feel better he’s back to his normal self. 10/10 this is going to be our regularly vet!
It was so informative and comforting. Dezy made sure both me and my dog got the information that we needed to get my dog into peak shape.

Dr Troppy and Leyla were amazing today made my cat Tangerine very comfortable and were very helpful to get to the root of the problem I would definitely recommend more people to come take care of your fur babies 💯🙏

Upon arrival, Brittany was super accommodating and informative. Great service from staff overall. Leyla the technician was very loving towards my sweet Dolly girl and Dr. Troppy was very informative as well

I love going to Vetco. They always take great care of my dogs. I can also use them nationwide. And the physicians and staff are just amazing. Tech Leyla at the San Antonio location is amazing so thorough and listens to you with all your concerns. But would recommend Vetco in general for taking care of your babies.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
This location SUCKS BAD, Terrible rude works that need to go back to training in how to better support customers
This is my first visit and everyone was amazing. The room was nice and clean. I would definitely recommend them.

Had an amazing experience at Vetco in San Antonio with my small dog. The entire staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and made us feel comfortable from the moment we walked in. They treated my little dog with so much care, patience, and kindness, which meant a lot to me as a pet owner. The process was also very quick and efficient we were in and out without feeling rushed, and everything was handled professionally. It’s hard to find a place that combines speed, compassion, and great customer service, but Vetco definitely delivered. Highly recommend to anyone looking for excellent care for their pets!
